about: hello.ident from src/main/pairing.js (protocol 2, optional field). The host signs signedText = context + hello.auth.nonce + "|" + (cnonce or "") + "|" + hostId + "|" + viewerId (UTF-8) with its Ed25519 identity key; the signature is standard base64 of 64 bytes, keys are raw 32 bytes in base64url without padding. keys: fixed test keys from 32-byte seeds (PKCS8 = the RFC 8410 prefix + seed). rfc8032: standard Ed25519 known answers the port must reproduce. functions.verifyIdent args = [pub (base64url), hello, expect?]; reasons in check order: no-ident, malformed, bad-signature, cnonce-mismatch, host-mismatch, viewer-mismatch. Not covered on purpose: small-order public keys (Ed25519 libraries differ there; a real host key never is one). Regenerate with node scripts/make-mobile-fixtures.js.

identBytes.about: identBytes(nonce, cnonce, hostId, viewerId) -> the signed text (its UTF-8 bytes are what is signed). nonce: canonical base64 of 16..64 bytes; cnonce: null or canonical base64 of 32 bytes; IDs: /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/. Errors, checked in argument order: BAD_NONCE, BAD_CNONCE, BAD_BINDING.

cases.note: no client nonce (desktop viewer): an empty field
an empty string is not "no client nonce"

validCnonce.about: validCnonce(value) -> bool: the x-tunnelview-client-nonce header value and ident.cnonce: canonical standard base64 of exactly 32 bytes (44 characters, one "="). The host answers HTTP 400 to a malformed header.

verifyIdent.about: verifyIdent(pub, hello, expect?) -> {ok:true, reason:null, hostId, viewerId, cnonce} or {ok:false, reason}. expect = what the viewer knows ({cnonce, hostId, viewerId}); a key that is present is compared exactly. Unknown ident fields are ignored; cnonce must be present (a string or null). A pub that is not 32 bytes is a caller bug: error BAD_KEY.

cases.note: a desktop viewer: no client nonce
cnonce must be sent, as null when absent
S + L: the same signature modulo L; RFC 8032 requires S < L

several mismatches: the first in check order wins
